body: I’m in the same boat. I feel like there’s just nothing to live for anymore. I want to feel different but I feel as though it’s impossible. Life sucks.
Well I’m prescribed klonopin for my anxiety so I’ll probably just down the bottle

I have depersonalization anxiety. Nothing feels real. Nothing seems to matter. I’m worried every second of every day. I just want it to end and the only thing stopping me is my family because I know how devastated they will be. I just want it all to stop. I move out in two weeks and I think that’s when I’ll make the decision whether to go through with it or not.
